# `hub.permission_state`

Private permission-storage state. Its presence does not activate policy evaluation.

Database: `hub`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | INTEGER | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Private singleton key, always one. |
| `generation` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Private authority-input generation; never a public cursor. |
| `mode` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Legacy storage or explicitly activated policy; storage migration retains legacy. |
| `catalog_version` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Accepted catalog version in policy mode; null in legacy mode. |
| `catalog_sha256` | VARCHAR(64) | yes | — | — | — | — | Canonical complete root catalog digest; null in legacy mode. |
| `catalog_json` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Canonical complete catalog using actual root defaults; null in legacy mode. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | yes | — | — | — | — | Policy-state update time; unknown at migration. |
| `updated_by` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Policy-state update actor; unknown at migration. |
| `updated_via` | VARCHAR(16) | yes | — | — | — | — | Policy-state update interface; unknown at migration. |
